consent.title: Before you begin
consent.notDiagnostic: SETU is not a diagnostic tool. It does not detect, diagnose, or rule out any condition.
consent.demoDataNotice: This is a hackathon prototype. Any sample data you see is self-recorded or simulated, never real clinical data.
consent.clinicianReviewNotice: SETU produces structured observations for a qualified clinician to review — it is screening support, not a result.
